name: Craft original movie plot outlines and synopses
description: Users requested the creation of detailed plot outlines, synopses, and high-level concept summaries for various fictional films, TV series, and animated works. Many of these requests involved reimagining existing franchises, proposing sequels or prequels, generating crossover scenarios, or developing original stories with specific thematic or character-based constraints.
